hero.headline: Trusted Engineering for Advanced Medical Technology Programs

overview.heading: Industry Overview
body: The medical technology (MedTech) industry is evolving rapidly, driven by an aging population, growing demand for diagnostic and therapeutic devices, advances in digital health, and expanding access to healthcare worldwide. As products become more sophisticated, manufacturers must accelerate production while maintaining quality, compliance, and patient safety.

Manufacturing automation helps meet these demands by improving production consistency, reducing process variability, and creating scalable operations that can adapt as products and market needs evolve. Perellion designs and builds custom manufacturing automation, inspection systems, and test equipment for medical device manufacturers. Final device manufacturing and regulatory release remain the responsibility of the device manufacturer.

challenges.heading: Industry Challenges
challenges.intro: Every production decision has the potential to affect product quality, validation activities, regulatory compliance, and ultimately, patient safety. Manufacturers must balance increasing product complexity with compressed launch schedules, supply chain uncertainty, labor shortages, and rising production costs. At the same time, many devices now combine miniature components, electronics, software, and precision assemblies that require tighter process control than ever before. Success depends on more than automating production, as manufacturers need repeatable processes, reliable inspection, and comprehensive traceability that support quality throughout the product lifecycle while making validation more predictable.
circleLabels: Managing complex supply chains for high-value, low-volume assemblies

help.heading: How Perellion Helps
body: Every medical device presents its own manufacturing challenges, but the objective remains the same: build products safely, consistently, and with confidence. Perellion helps manufacturers achieve those goals through solutions including:

Precision assembly automation
Machine vision inspection and quality verification
Functional, electrical, and leak testing systems
Precision dispensing and material handling
Manufacturing traceability and production data collection
Process development and validation support

Rather than delivering standalone equipment, we design integrated manufacturing systems that improve process control, strengthen product quality, and support long-term operational performance in regulated environments.

risk.heading: Example applications
body: Perellion can support automation programs across a wide range of medical device manufacturing environments, including:

Automated assembly systems for disposable diagnostic cartridges
Vision inspection systems for IV tubing and fluid management component
Leak testing equipment for drug delivery devices
Robotic packaging systems for surgical kits
Traceability and serialization systems for regulated medical products
Functional test equipment for wearable medical electronics
Precision dispensing systems for adhesives and specialty materials
Manufacturing fixtures and tooling for catheter production

Every application is engineered around the product, manufacturing process, and regulatory requirements, helping customers improve repeatability, simplify validation, and prepare production for future growth.

faq.q: What types of medical device manufacturing automation does Perellion provide?
faq.a: Perellion develops custom automation for precision assembly, material handling, dispensing, inspection, testing, packaging, and traceability. Each system is engineered around the medical device, manufacturing process, and production requirements.

faq.q: Can Perellion design custom manufacturing automation for medical devices
faq.a: Perellion designs custom manufacturing automation for complex processes that may not fit standard equipment. Systems can combine robotics, precision tooling, inspection, testing, controls, and material handling based on the needs of the application.

faq.q: How does Perellion support medical device manufacturing validation and regulatory compliance?
faq.a: Perellion designs automation to support process repeatability, reliable inspection and testing, traceability, and validation activities. Final device validation, regulatory compliance, and product release remain the responsibility of the manufacturer.
